CancelAgentSession.description_en: Stops a session execution or cancels a specified turn
CancelAgentSession.description_zh: 请求停止会话执行，或取消指定回合

CreateAgentSession.description_en: Creates a text session for a specified agent and obtains the session ID required for subsequent calls
CreateAgentSession.description_zh: 为指定智能体创建文本会话，取得后续调用所需的会话 ID

CreateTransitUploadPolicy.description_en: Generates credentials for direct file upload. Callers can use the returned upload policy to upload files directly to object storage
CreateTransitUploadPolicy.description_zh: 生成文件直传凭证。调用方可以使用返回的上传策略将文件直接上传到对象存储

DeleteAgentSession.description_en: Deletes an idle session that is no longer needed
DeleteAgentSession.description_zh: 删除不再需要的空闲会话

DeleteSkill.description_en: Soft-deletes a skill that the current caller has permission to modify
DeleteSkill.description_zh: 软删除当前调用者有权修改的 Skill

GetAgent.description_en: Queries agents visible to the current identity by name
GetAgent.description_zh: 按名称查询当前身份可见的 Agent

GetAgentSession.description_en: Queries session details such as the title, associated agent, and core timestamps based on the session ID
GetAgentSession.description_zh: 根据会话 ID 查询标题、所属智能体和核心时间等会话详情

GetAgentSessionModel.description_en: Queries the model and thinking level configurations currently used by the session
GetAgentSessionModel.description_zh: 查询会话当前使用的模型及思考等级配置

GetSkill.description_en: Queries the skills visible to the current caller by name
GetSkill.description_zh: 按名称查询当前调用者可见的 Skill

GetTransitMeta.description_en: Queries the metadata of a transit file, such as the upload status, file size, and expiration time, and retrieves a temporary download URL on demand
GetTransitMeta.description_zh: 查询 Transit 文件的上传状态、文件大小、过期时间等元数据，并可按需获取临时下载链接

ListAgentSessions.description_en: Queries the session summary by paging for the caller to select or resume existing sessions
ListAgentSessions.description_zh: 分页查询会话摘要，供调用方选择或继续已有会话

ListAgents.description_en: Queries the agents visible to the current identity by using paging
ListAgents.description_zh: 分页查询当前身份可见的 Agent

ListModels.description_en: Queries the text models visible to the current caller for selection when setting a session model
ListModels.description_zh: 查询当前调用方可见的文本模型，供设置会话模型时选择

ListSkills.description_en: Performs a paging query for skills visible to the current invoker
ListSkills.description_zh: 分页查询当前调用者可见的 Skill

LoadAgentSession.description_en: Loads session history, receives subsequent output, or resumes Server-Sent Events (SSE) from a saved read position
LoadAgentSession.description_zh: 加载会话历史、接收后续输出，或从已保存的读取位置恢复 SSE

PromptAgentSession.description_en: Sends text to an existing session and continuously receives agent output over Server-Sent Events (SSE)
PromptAgentSession.description_zh: 向已有会话发送文本，并通过 SSE 持续接收智能体输出

ReplyAgentSession.description_en: Submits the approval choice or question answer for the current pending interaction
ReplyAgentSession.description_zh: 提交当前待处理交互的审批选择或问题答案

SetAgentSessionModel.description_en: Sets the model used by a session and optionally configures the thinking level
SetAgentSessionModel.description_zh: 设置会话使用的模型，并可选配置思考等级

UpdateAgent.description_en: Updates the configuration of an agent
